```sql
SELECT WorkOrderCloseID, WorkOrderID, CloseDate,
    MaterialVarianceAmount AS Material,
    DirectLaborVarianceAmount AS Labor,
    OverheadVarianceAmount AS Overhead,
    TotalVarianceAmount AS Total,
    ROUND(OverheadVarianceAmount / TotalVarianceAmount, 2)
        AS OverheadShare
FROM WorkOrderClose
```
